ns2:course.label: Advanced Structural Geology
ns2:course.description: Study of selected topics concerning rock deformation processes and products. Introduces current research literature and methods, and the techniques of structural analysis. May include an optional field trip. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: GEOL 411 or equivalent; consent of instructor.
